entries.text: # Add to Cart Feature: Product Requirements ## Purpose Customers must be able to collect items in a cart before they pay. ## Quantity limits A customer can add at most 10 units of the same item. A cart can hold at most 50 different items. ## Out of stock items An item that is out of stock cannot be

An item that is out of stock cannot be added to the cart. The Add to Cart button is replaced by a message saying the item is unavailable. ## Prices The price shown in the cart includes tax. The price is checked again at checkout, and the customer is told if it has changed. ## Saved carts A cart of a

has changed. ## Saved carts A cart of a signed-in customer is saved for 7 days. A cart of a visitor who is not signed in is lost when the browser is closed. ## Duplication Of Items If any item is already added into the cart and user is adding it again then it should update the quantity. It should

should update the quantity. It should not show same item two times. The limit of 10 units per item still applies when an item is added again. If the new total would be more than 10, the quantity is set to 10 and the customer sees a message that explains the limit.

1. ## Discount codes A customer can apply one discount code per order. A second code replaces the first one. Codes are not case sensitive. ## Order limits The maximum order value is 5000 dollars. An order above this limit is rejected with a message asking the customer to contact support. ## Failed

customer to contact support. ## Failed payments If a payment fails, the cart is kept for 24 hours so the customer can try again. The customer must see a clear message that explains why the payment failed. ## Refunds A customer can request a refund within 5 days of delivery. Refunds are paid back to
of delivery. Refunds are paid back to the original payment method within 5 working days.

# Login Feature: Product Requirements ## Purpose Registered customers must be able to sign in to see their orders and saved details. ## Password rules A password must have at least 8 characters, including one number and one capital letter. ## Account lock After 5 failed sign-in attempts in a row,

5 failed sign-in attempts in a row, the account is locked for 15 minutes. The customer sees a message that tells them how long to wait. ## Session timeout A signed-in customer is signed out automatically after 30 minutes of no activity. ## Password reset A customer can ask for a password reset link
can ask for a password reset link by email. The link works for 1 hour and can be used only once.

# Orders API Reference ## Create an order Send a POST request to /orders with a list of items and a payment method. A successful request returns status 201 and the new order id. ## Get an order Send a GET request to /orders/{id}. It returns status 200 with the order details. If the id does not

the order details. If the id does not exist, it returns status 404. ## Cancel an order Send a DELETE request to /orders/{id}. An order can only be cancelled before it is shipped. After that, the API returns status 409. ## Authentication Every request needs an API key in the header named x-api-key. A

key in the header named x-api-key. A missing or wrong key returns status 401. ## Rate limits Each API key can send 100 requests per minute. Above that, the API returns status 429 and the client must wait before trying again.

# Shipping Notes Orders are shipped within 2 working days of payment. Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 working days. Express delivery takes 1 working day and costs 15 dollars extra. Orders above 100 dollars ship for free.
